description: Give the user or another agent a file, a folder or a secret without it passing through this chat. Large files work too: free up to a limit, more after one card payment by the user. Once the user's inbox is connected (seal_pair), the file lands there and there is nothing to copy. Otherwise the link goes to the user's clipboard and you get a handle. Where there is no clipboard, it goes to a private file and you get its path: do not read or print that file. With `to`, a SEAL address, it goes into that person's or agent's inbox, with any rules. Mode `forward` gives you a link only the agent at `to` opens, once, within 30 minutes: use it to lend another agent a key or pass it a link in the chat. Every seal you make also appears in the connected user's inbox, where they manage and revoke it. Never paste secrets or large content into the chat instead.

bind.description: Lend a key instead of giving it, with kind=secret or `key` and mode=forward with `to`. The recipient's guard holds the value and puts it in only at these hosts; their agent sees a stand-in. seal_revoke takes the key back. Where the recipient runs no guard, the value lands in their file, and a receipt in your inbox says so.

burn.description: Delete the seal after its last open. Default true.

countries.description: The countries the seal opens from, as two-letter codes (`US`, `DE`; `UK` reads as `GB`); without it, anywhere. It opens only from networks in these countries. Not with mode=forward.

expire.description: How long the link lives. Default: 1h for a handoff, 1d for one over 100 MB and for the inbox, 5m for forward, which allows at most 30m. Above the free limit: 1d or 7d, default 1d.

key.description: With `path` to a .env-style file: send only the value of this variable, as a secret named after it. Lines `NAME=value` or `export NAME=value`, `#` lines skipped, one pair of matching quotes stripped. The value is never written to disk.

kind.description: `secret` for a password, API key or token: the recipient's agent saves it to a file and never reads it into a chat; in a browser it is shown hidden, not downloaded. Not together with `mime`.

max_reads.description: How many times the seal opens; it is deleted after the last. Forward allows one.

message.description: A message to the recipient, encrypted inside the seal. With `nda` it is the agreement's text.

mime.description: The MIME type, when the one guessed from the name is wrong. It travels encrypted with the file and decides how the recipient's side shows it.

mode.description: Where the link goes. `inbox`: into the inbox of `to`, else the connected user's. `handoff`: to the user's clipboard, without `to`. `forward`: back to you, for the agent at `to`. Without it: `inbox` when `to` is given or the user's inbox is connected, else `handoff`.

nda.description: The recipient, a person in a browser, signs an agreement before the download: on a handoff link's page, or opening the seal from the inbox of `to`. Not with mode=forward or the user's own inbox. Needs `owner_email` and `message`.

owner_email.description: The user's email: a letter each time the seal is opened, with when and from which country. With `nda`, the signed agreement is sent there too. Use only an address the user gave for this.

password.description: A password the recipient enters: 6 to 10 characters, and 10 when it is digits only. Use only one the user said in this conversation; otherwise `password_file`.

password_file.description: Path of a file whose first line is the password: the path seal_request returns for kind=secret. The password never enters this conversation. Not together with `password`.

path.description: Absolute path of the file or folder to share. A folder goes as one `<folder>.zip` of its regular files, without symlinks. It streams from disk: do not read it yourself. Required unless `payment` is given.

payment.description: Handle of a share waiting for its payment: wait for it and finish the upload.

tier.description: Above the free limit only: the tier the user pays for once by card. Default: the smallest that fits. Prices are on seal.net/pricing.

to.description: A SEAL address, 43 characters: a person's inbox shows it on box.seal.net, an agent prints it with `sealnet-mcp pubkey` or `seal keygen`. The seal goes into that inbox, with any rules, and no link reaches the chat. Required for mode=forward; not with mode=handoff.

name: seal_share
title: Share a file or a secret via SEAL
